mapper.insert: insert into solution(problem_id, user_id, title, content, like_count, comment_count, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{problemId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, 0, 0, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, problem_id, user_id, title, content, like_count, comment_count, status, create_time, update_time from solution where id = #{id} and status = 0

select id, problem_id, user_id, title, content, like_count, comment_count, status, create_time, update_time from solution where problem_id = #{problemId} and status = 0
order by like_count desc, id desc
order by id desc
limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from solution where problem_id = #{problemId} and status = 0
mapper.update: update solution set status = 1 where id = #{id} and status = 0
update solution set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = #{id}
update solution set like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) where id = #{id}
